/Now

Updated November 2026. Tokyo.

Right now I live in Tokyo, and work as an engineering manager leading platform architecture at a fin-tech company. Recently I have been thinking a lot about symmetry, security and AI.

What's on my plate?

  • Japanese: Studying Japanese with a target of sitting the JLPT this December, and a bigger target to be conversationally advanced. Currently at about 500 kanji and somewhere between N4 and N3 grammar. I am beginning to read/write more in Japanese and to consume Japanese media.
  • Fitness: Improving my fitness. My priority is cardio > strength. Still looking into options for flexibility.
  • Inner-Work: Through early adulthood and moving around a lot, I have discovered a lot about myself over the years, and am actively working on putting lessons into practice.

What are my long-term goals?

  • As AK used to say: Love, health and wealth.
  • This year, failing all three, a sub-27 5K.

What am I enjoying right now?

  • Watching: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Vivant, Nathan For You
  • Listening: Various neurofunk mixes, and Sakanaction.
  • Reading: Wind and Truth by Brandon Sanderson & Supercommunicators by Charles Duhigg

What's happening with the blog?

I'm still mostly writing weeknotes, but am actively exploring alternative formats. This year I wrote a meta-piece on hobbies in Japanese and a long-form piece on #times channels.

Side Projects:

To sharpen my skills and hone new ones, I have a been working on a few side-projects designed to seamlessly fit into various areas of my life.

  • Densha.Tokyo: A free-to-use TfL-inspired status-board for all of Tokyo's train-lines, designed to "Just Work". I use it every day. This was built as a competition-entry and does a lot in the background including translating status messages.
  • YAKS: A study app for Japanese, and the most advanced thing I have built on my own. While developing YAKS I have done a lot of studying about studying, and have been steadily incorporating this into the product so that other users can benefit.
  • Meanwhile: I have never found a timer app which I have stuck with, so I have built an iOS app for fitness, productivity and routine timers. I am currently dogfooding this and plan to share it.
  • Unified Ruby: A Unified library for rendering Ruby-text (or Furigana) in Markdown. I use this in other projects and plan to maintain it for the foreseeable future.
  • Feed Reader: I follow my friends' blogs and several news websites, and have built a feed reader to make this a more enjoyable ritual. It is built on this blog's tech stack and uses a small ELT pipeline for feed-fetching. However I am not sure the time ROI is good, so I may end this experiment.
  • ImageCDN: A long-term side-project as an image resizing & optimizing CDN. It is in maintenance mode while it continues to serve a vast amount of traffic per month, and I am occasionally improving the CDN performance.

What am I not doing?

I recently worked out what my priorities are for the remainder of the year, and I am basically avoiding anything which doesn't align with that.

This is a now page, my weeknotes are more granular updates of what I've been up to.
